rules.rule: Verify Zod or equivalent runtime validation, server-side authentication and resource authorization, same-origin protection for mutations, safe error responses, bounded queries, and atomic transactions for wallet or ownership changes. Reject client-supplied identity, price, balance, and ownership fields.

Verify Prisma client reuse, adapter configuration, secret handling, server-only boundaries, and production-safe logging. Do not recommend changing the database provider or connection configuration without concrete evidence.

Check authentication and authorization boundaries, same-origin mutation protection, ownership scoping, sensitive error redaction, rate-limit key safety, transaction boundaries, concurrency behavior, and bounded database access.

Check that uniqueness constraints, relations, indexes, decimal and money fields support the actual query and transaction patterns. Do not propose migrations or provider changes without concrete query evidence.

Preserve all --reader-* theme variables and reader behavior. Check keyboard navigation, visible focus, aria labels for icon controls, dialog focus restoration, reduced motion, safe-area layouts, and avoid rebuilding the chapter text tree when appearance settings change.
Check accessible media controls, cancellation and cleanup, stale async response protection, Media Session integration, theme-variable inheritance through portals, and unnecessary React re-renders.

Prefer existing components/ui and components/shared primitives. Check semantic HTML, keyboard access, visible focus, stable component identity, Server Component boundaries, and avoid unnecessary client state or memoization.
